properties.description: no_served_text_names_a_tool_that_is_not_served.rs reads every served tool description and input-schema description (tools/list with lessons), every Markdown file of the served kit (getting-started/: skills and instructions), schema/*.yaml (what describe_schema serves), and every string literal in crates/reflow2-core/src and crates/reflow2-mcp/src (the fixed prose of replies and refusals; deprecation.rs excepted, whose job is to name a removed tool to refuse it). It fails on any removed tool (a deprecation-registry tool the served list no longer carries) named as a whole word, and on a backticked tool-like name after "call" that nothing serves. Anti-vacuity: more than 5,000 literals and at least 20 "call `tool`" sentences must be read; the_reader_sees_the_shapes_it_names pins the literal reader (comments, raw strings, continuations, char literals and lifetimes) both ways. Not read: a never-served name in plain prose with no backticks and no "call", and graph text.
properties.findings: On main 02e2739c8 it FAILS naming exactly the five texts the finding found: detect.rs:6910, edge_prose.rs:183, hierarchy.rs:651, temporal.rs:1030 and schema/temporal.yaml:19, each naming `record_change`; manual_work_report is named by no served text. With the fix it passes (2026-10-26).
